habitat: Dense coniferous forests; mixed forests; bogs; meadows; and open areas near forests
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Great Grey Owl (Strix nebulosa) stands out. This species, part of the Strigidae family, is a resident of Dense coniferous forests; mixed forests; bogs; meadows; and open areas near forests. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Great Grey Owl is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Great Grey Owl and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
